## Details

<a id="shape_mirror_table"></a>
### [`shape_mirror_table`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_lookup_tables.asm#L6) `$7E00-$7EFF`

*data*

Mirror table: entry b is b with its four 2-bit multicolour pixels in reverse order. shape_copy_mirrored_part ($3e3d) uses it for facing 1.

- **Read by:** [`shape_copy_mirrored_part`](shape_build_mirror.md#shape_copy_mirrored_part)

<a id="shape_part_page_table"></a>
### [`shape_part_page_table`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_lookup_tables.asm#L24) `$7F00-$7FFF`

*data*

No frame uses part $fc ($bf00-$bf3f); entries 0 and $fc are the only ones that no run read.

- **Read by:** [`shape_build`](shape_build_390c.md#shape_build), [`shape_copy_mirrored_part`](shape_build_mirror.md#shape_copy_mirrored_part)
